purpose: Reference example for future detection of an impulse continuation formation with measured-move target projection

target_model.long: Measure the first impulse from the pre-impulse trough to the new significant high and project the same price distance upward for continuation
target_model.short: Mirror the long logic: measure the first downside impulse from the pre-impulse peak to the new significant low and project the same price distance downward

desired_behavior: Detect a strong impulse that updates the previous significant extreme in one directional movement
Identify the structural trough or peak preceding the impulse
Distinguish the post-impulse pause from a full trend reversal
Calculate continuation potential using the measured-move 1 equals 2 principle
Support mirrored LONG and SHORT variants
notes: User-defined formation currently called L-Shaped Impulse Continuation. Preserve as a future Pattern Engine reference. Do not implement until current wedge calibration and reliability work is stabilized.
